subject: Connector revenue split protocol and lead-registration details
messages:
From: Chris Miller <chris@stellarops.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro — commercial framework for connector resale / referral

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking a quick call last week. As discussed, StellarOps is building a managed integration for your cloud connector and we'd like to align commercial terms so we can co-sell. High-level asks from our side:

- 20% referral fee on first-year ARR for pure referrals (no implementation),
- 35% revenue split on reseller deals where StellarOps invoices and delivers integration + implementation,
- Lead registration window: 90 days from first intro, with a 60-day active negotiation extension if both parties agree.

We can share an initial term sheet and will be happy to accept a small integration credit to lower implementation risk (we suggested a $15k upfront credit).

Attached is a short term sheet and our proposed fee schedule. Can we lock a pilot econ for the first two customers, then move to standard waterfall?

Thanks — Chris
StellarOps Partnerships

Attachment: stellarops_term_sheet_v1.pdf
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Chris Miller <chris@stellarops.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@stellarops.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — commercial framework for connector resale / referral

Chris / Lena —

Appreciate the clear proposal and the term sheet. A few quick clarifications from Redwood's side before Ben and our operations team dig in: 

- We prefer a 60-day registration hold (not 90) for referrals to keep our pipeline hygiene consistent with other partners.
- For reseller/integrator deals where StellarOps invoices, Redwood usually requires a three-tier waterfall (intro credit first, implementation share second, and 12-month retention kicker third). Typical splits are 10% intro / 40% implementation / 15% retention (totaling 65% share to partner in your 35%-we-pay scenario). We can be flexible on the exact numbers for early pilots.
- Clawback window: Redwood standard is 6 months prorated for cancellations; we prefer a prorated approach.

Ben — can you outline the pilot econ and any constraints on providing an integration credit? Also, legal will need to confirm acceptable audit and reporting cadence (monthly settlement, quarterly statements).

Next steps: Ben will send a redline of the fee schedule; Karthik, would you own the registration rules and the Ops playbook?

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_partner_term_sheet_v1.pdf
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — commercial framework for connector resale / referral

Quick notes on the pilot econ and integration credit: 

- We can cover an integration credit up to $12,500 as a pilot concession (payable as a one-time rebate against first invoice) — $15k in Chris's ask is slightly above our threshold.
- Proposed pilot waterfall (two customers): 12% intro / 45% implementation / 8% retention kicker (total 65% partner share) for 6 months, then revert to a standard 10/40/15 split after review.
- Settlement cadence: monthly invoicing with net-30 payouts to StellarOps; Redwood will provide line-item token usage and model tier reports for reconciliation.
- Clawback: 6-month prorated, but we can offer a softened schedule for first pilot (90-day full protection, then prorated months 4–6).

I'll draft a redline and attach the integration fee spreadsheet. Karthik — we need the registration policy language for contract insertion (short, precise).

Ben
Ben Carter
Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: integration_fee_schedule.xlsx
From: Lena Park <lena.park@stellarops.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — commercial framework for connector resale / referral

Ben / Grace —

Thanks for the flexibility. A couple of counterpoints from our GTM team: 

- The 60-day registration hold is workable if Redwood guarantees 48-hour lead-response SLA and joint demo availability for co-sells. We require a clear lead-scoring handoff to avoid duplicate outreach.
- On the integration credit, StellarOps can accept $12.5k as a pilot, but requests it be documented as a refundable credit if a signed SOW does not materialize within 120 days.
- Regarding the waterfall, we'd like to keep the 35% reseller gross share and ask Redwood to consider a 9-month retention kicker (instead of 12-month) tied to active usage thresholds.

We can accept your monthly settlement cadence. Please send the redline and the registration language and we'll route to legal.

Best,
Lena
Head of Commercial Partnerships, StellarOps
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@stellarops.com>, Chris Miller <chris@stellarops.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — commercial framework for connector resale / referral

Folks — here is a concise registration policy draft suitable for insertion into the MSA / SOW: 

1) Registration window: Redwood accepts partner registrations for 60 days from the date of first written introduction (email or logged HubSpot activity).
2) Extension: Either party may request one 30-day extension if actively engaged in negotiation; both parties must confirm in writing.
3) Exclusivity: Registrations are non-exclusive; Redwood retains the right to continue pursuing independent leads unless a signed SOW is executed.
4) Duplicate claim resolution: If duplicate introductions occur, the earliest HubSpot timestamped owner wins; disputes escalate to Partner Ops for adjudication within 5 business days.
5) Clawback: 6-month prorated; partner may request softening for pilot customers as noted in the SOW.

I'll include this as clause 7.3 in the redline. Ben — attaching suggested insertion text for finance to reconcile with payout flows.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Partnerships Operations, Redwood Inference

Grace / Ben / Karthik —

This looks good and aligns closely with what our CFO needs. We accept the $12.5k pilot credit as refundable if there's no SOW in 120 days. We'll take the 60-day registration window with a single 30-day extension and agree to the 48-hour lead-response SLA. For the retention kicker, we can do 9 months tied to usage thresholds.

Please send the redline and the DocuSign envelope when ready and we'll aim to sign within 7 business days. I'll ask Legal to review the registration clause but the wording Karthik shared seems straightforward.

Thanks — Chris
